review.summary: Ready for Dana. All 12 bank lines are accounted for, and duplicate T-0611 is left out with a reason and a question to the client. My own totals match the draft: $14,935.00 in, $8,349.39 out, $6,585.61 net, and the books tie to the $19,035.61 statement balance to the cent. Categories (including Acme's Greenleaf rule R-DEMO-003), receipts and the message to Maria all check out. R-DEMO-001 (Acme's close goes out on the 3rd) is about send timing, which is the approver's job.
